title: Administrator - Payroll and Benefits
description:
Administrator - Payroll and Benefits

Location: Bracknell

Contract Type: Temporary

Contract Length: 3 months

Working Pattern: Full Time, 35hours per week

Working Hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Hourly Rate: 20.00 - 25.00

The position is hybrid, with an expectation to work in the Bracknell office for two days a week, specifically on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, and full-time in the office during the initial training period.

Key Responsibilities:
- Collaborate with third-party payroll providers by preparing files for payroll processing, reviewing, and finalising monthly payrolls.
- Process and issue employee pay slips and statements of earnings and deductions.
- Compile and analyse employee time, production, and payroll data from timesheets and other records.
- Review timesheets, work charts, and wage computations to identify and reconcile discrepancies.
- Verify attendance and hours worked, making necessary pay adjustments and maintaining accurate payroll records.
- Record employee information, including exemptions, transfers, and resignations, to ensure up-to-date payroll documentation.
- Issue and record adjustments to pay related to past errors or retroactive increases.
- Stay informed about changes in tax and deduction laws applicable to payroll processing.
- Provide guidance to employees and managers on payroll matters, tax issues, and overall direction on time and attendance systems.
- Assist payroll management with projects, including system conversions and process improvement initiatives.
- Maintain robust procedures to ensure data privacy and security within the payroll department, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
- Manage HR recordkeeping and the company's timekeeping systems concerning employee leave and time off.
- Oversee benefit enrollments for new starters, leavers, and employees experiencing changes in circumstances.
- Maintain accurate employee benefit records within the HR/payroll system and provider portals.
- Process monthly benefit changes, ensuring accurate information is provided to payroll within agreed deadlines.
- Reconcile benefit deductions and employer contributions against payroll and provider records, investigating any discrepancies.
- Serve as the first point of contact for employees regarding benefit inquiries, providing clear and accurate guidance.
- Support the preparation and administration of UK taxable benefits and benefits-in-kind, including necessary information for P11 D/payrolling processes.

Ideal candidate:
- Previous experience in payroll and human resources information systems
- Solid knowledge of payroll and accounting practises and principles for the UK and Ireland.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Organised and results-driven approach to work.
- Proven administrative experience in a busy office environment.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word.
- Experience managing shared mailboxes and handling high-volume email activity.
- Ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in all tasks.
- Confidence in following written processes and instructions.

We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.

title: Payroll offer & HR admin assistant
description:
We are recruiting an organised and detail-oriented HR & Payroll Officer to manage end-to-end monthly payroll across six group companies, alongside providing day-to-day HR administrative support. You must drive due to location and the need to go to their other site in Sunbury.

Payroll will be the primary focus of the role, with additional responsibility for HR administration, employee queries, onboarding, absence management and maintaining HR records and systems. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong payroll background who enjoys a varied role and is keen to develop their involvement in HR.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage end-to-end monthly payroll across six group companies, ensuring accurate and timely processing.
- Process starters, leavers, salary changes, overtime, bonuses and statutory payments.
- Manage HMRC submissions, year-end processes, pensions and auto-enrolment.
- Act as the first point of contact for payroll and general HR queries, managing the HR inbox and responding to employee requests.
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, change letters and other HR documentation.
- Coordinate new starter and leaver administration, including payroll and HR system updates.
- Maintain employee records and workflows within BambooHR, ensuring data accuracy.
- Monitor sickness and absence records, update sick pay and support return-to-work administration.
- Assist with HR reporting, system integration and ongoing process improvements.
- Provide general HR administrative support and work closely with the wider HR team.

Requirements:
- Previous experience managing payroll from start to finish.
- Good understanding of HMRC submissions, pensions and statutory payments.
- Previous HR administration experience or a genuine interest in developing within HR.
- Strong IT skills and confidence using payroll and HR systems.
- Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management.
- A proactive, flexible approach with the ability to manage confidential information.
- A team player who is happy to support colleagues across the wider HR function.

title: HR administrator ( 6 month contract)
description:
Are you highly organised, confident with Excel and someone who loves keeping things running smoothly?

We're looking for a proactive, organised and adaptable HR administrator to join our busy HR team on a 6 month contract.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with strong administration skills who enjoys working with data, managing processes and supporting a variety of business functions. You don't necessarily need previous HR experience - we're much more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, excellent attention to detail and a willingness to learn.

You'll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of HR operations, with involvement in monthly payroll, employee administration, reporting and wider HR activities.

What will you be doing?
- Supporting the monthly payroll process, ensuring information is accurate and deadlines are met.
- Managing employee administration, including new starters, leavers and changes to employee details.
- Maintaining accurate records, spreadsheets and HR systems.
- Using Excel to manage data, produce reports and support regular reporting requirements.
- Responding to employee queries and providing a helpful, professional service.
- Supporting benefits, pensions and employee wellbeing administration.
- Assisting with onboarding, inductions and other employee lifecycle processes.
- Supporting HR projects and looking for ways to improve processes and efficiency.
- Working closely with colleagues across the business to ensure everything runs smoothly.

What are we looking for?
- Strong administration experience, ideally within a busy, fast-paced environment.
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and data.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with figures and confidential information.
- A flexible and adaptable approach - happy to get involved in different tasks and learn new things.
- A confident communicator with a helpful, team-focused attitude.
- Someone who takes ownership, uses their initiative and enjoys getting things done.

Previous HR or payroll experience would be advantageous, but it is not essential. We are happy to consider candidates from a general administration, finance, payroll, operations or coordination background.

What's on offer?
- Salary of 35,000 per annum.
- The opportunity to develop your skills across HR operations and payroll.
- A varied role where no two days are quite the same.
- The opportunity to join a collaborative and supportive team.

Interested?

If you're an organised administrator with strong Excel skills, a proactive attitude and an interest in developing your experience within HR and payroll, we'd love to hear from you.
